newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Energy surges on Amoco talk.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Energy surges on Amoco talk.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy shares surged 1-1/4 to 8-1/4 on rumors that Amoco Corp was set to buy the company, analysts said.
"The stock is up on the Amoco rumor, but I do not believe it," said an analyst who declined to be named.
Chesapeake topped the New York Stock Exchange's list of most-active shares.
Amoco declined to comment, saying that it never commented on market speculation.
The analyst said that Chesapeake has interests in the Tuscaloosa onshore natural gas producing region in Louisiana, where there is an overlap with Amoco.
A spokesman for Chesapeake said that he knew of no reason why the stock had surged today and that the company had not met with analysts or made any announcement which could account for the rise.
"I have never viewed this as a takeover target, management owns 42 percent of the company and I just do not see them selling out," said another analyst.
Chesapeake shares traded as high as $32 this year, but the stock sold off sharply.
Then in June, the stock went down even further after the company said it would take a pre-tax write-down of $150-$200 million as a result of disappointing drilling results in Louisiana.
"The two top executives built this company up from scratch and are not going to sell out at this price," said the second analyst.
